units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905

zones.comment: where all thirty of the map's fail teleports put a player
the seamless portal into the end room. Its pair (-> td_end_facade) is the way back and is left as ordinary geometry

author: Juxtapo and Phurix
notes: Three bonuses labelled, a main route that is not. Every fail on the main route -- and there are thirty of them -- teleports to td_mapstart, so td_mapstart is the start line whatever the info_player_* entities say; the spawn is moved onto it for the same reason. The finish is the seamless portal at the far -X end of the ride, which lands the player in td_end_room: the map is longer than Source's 16384-unit world and the end room is folded back into the other corner of it. Its third bonus has a start zone, eight checkpoints and no finish anywhere in the map, so it is dropped rather than offered as a track nobody can complete.
